title: 8849 metrli Everest okean tubiga sig'adimi?
hook: Eng baland tog'ni eng chuqur joyga botiramiz.

scenes.text: Dunyodagi eng baland tog'ni okeanning eng chuqur joyiga botirib ko'ramiz.
scenes.keywords: snowy mountain peak above clouds aerial

scenes.text: Everest cho'qqisi dengiz sathidan 8849 metr balandda.
Tinch okeanidagi Mariana botig'ining eng chuqur nuqtasi, Chellenjer tubi, 10,9 kilometrdan ham chuqurroq.
scenes.keywords: deep blue ocean descending into darkness underwater

scenes.text: Demak, Everest butunlay suv ostida qoladi va cho'qqisi ustida yana ikki kilometrdan ortiq suv bo'ladi.
scenes.keywords: looking up from deep underwater toward surface light

scenes.text: Qizig'i, o'sha tubga Everest cho'qqisiga chiqqanlardan ancha kam odam tushgan.
scenes.keywords: deep sea submersible lights dark water

description:
Everest cho'qqisi dengiz sathidan 8849 metr balandda, Tinch okeanidagi Chellenjer tubi esa 10,9 kilometrdan chuqurroq. Shuning uchun Everestni u yerga qo'ysak, cho'qqisi ustida ikki kilometrdan ortiq suv qoladi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: all claims TRUE. Everest 8,848.86 m (rounded 8,849 m), joint China-Nepal announcement 8 Dec 2020, https://www.npr.org/2020/12/08/944152693/everest-gets-a-growth-spurt-as-china-nepal-revise-official-elevation-upward ; Challenger Deep about 10,935 m per NOAA (published figures roughly 10,900-10,994 m, so the script says only 'deeper than 10.9 km'; 10,935-8,849 = about 2,086 m of water over the summit), https://www.livescience.com/how-deep-is-the-mariana-trench ; Guinness World Records, deepest point in the sea, https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/deepest-point-in-the-sea ; people count: about 27 people have reached Challenger Deep as of 2025 versus more than 7,000 Everest summiters, https://www.earthdate.org/the-deepest-dive and https://haexpeditions.com/advice/how-many-people-have-climbed-mount-everest/ (counts vary by source, script says only 'ancha kam')
